from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyConstructionRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single month's construction statistics extracted from a specific report."""
    date: str = Field(description="The month the data corresponds to, in 'YYYY-MM' format")
    permits_saar: float = Field(description="The Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for total building permits (in units)")
    units_under_construction: float = Field(description="The Seasonally Adjusted number of total units under construction at end of period (in units)")
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="The date the report containing this data was released, in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format, used to resolve data precedence")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    construction_data_records: list[MonthlyConstructionRecord]
